info.about: Shantae is a 2002 platform video game developed by WayForward and originally published by Capcom for the Game Boy Color. The video game follows the adventures of the titular half-genie Shantae as she travels across Sequin Land to thwart the domination plans of the evil lady pirate Risky Boots.
info.why: Capcom published it in North America in June 2002, a year after the Game Boy Advance launched, and the tiny original print run makes it one of the scarcest licensed Game Boy Color releases.
